# Houdini nodes

The digital assets hdUE installs, with the help Houdini shows for them (F1 on a node), generated from the assets themselves.

## Solaris nodes (LOPs)

| Node | Summary |
|---|---|
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Decal](lop/hduedecal.md) | Creates or edits a UE decal: a box projecting its material onto the surfaces it covers. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Height Fog](lop/hdueheightfog.md) | Creates or edits a UE Exponential Height Fog: fog thickest below the prim's height. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Local Fog Volume](lop/hduelocalfogvolume.md) | Creates or edits a UE Local Fog Volume: a sphere of fog that fades out radially, rendered by hdUE. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Local Fog Volume 1.0](lop/hduelocalfogvolume-1.0.md) | Creates a UE Local Fog Volume: a sphere of fog that fades out radially, rendered by hdUE. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Post Process Volume](lop/hduepostprocessvolume.md) | Creates or edits a UE Post Process Volume: a box whose post-process settings blend in while the camera is inside or near it. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hduerenderproducts.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Render Products](lop/hduerenderproducts.md) | Creates render products sharing common settings. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hduerenderproperties.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Render Settings](lop/hduerendersettings.md) | Renders the stage with Unreal Engine: render settings, camera, resolution, output and AOVs. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Sky Atmosphere](lop/hdueskyatmosphere.md) | Creates or edits a UE Sky Atmosphere: UE's physical sky, lit by the distant lights. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hduestandardrendervars.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Standard Render Vars](lop/hduestandardrendervars.md) | Creates the render vars (AOVs) hdUE renders. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Unreal Asset](lop/hdueunrealasset.md) | Places an asset from a UE project (a Niagara effect, a mesh, a Blueprint, a level) and imports it into hdUE. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Volumetric Cloud](lop/hduevolumetriccloud.md) | Creates or edits a UE Volumetric Cloud layer, drawn with a Sky Atmosphere. |

## Substrate Builder nodes (VOPs)

| Node | Summary |
|---|---|
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Blackbody](vop/substrate_blackbody.md) | The color of a black body at a temperature (UE's BlackBody expression), for fire and hot gases. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Color Constant](vop/substrate_constant_color.md) | A constant color. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Color Parameter](vop/substrate_color.md) | A named color parameter of the material, editable on the material without recompiling. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Color Ramp](vop/substrate_color_ramp.md) | Maps a float to a color through a ramp (a UE curve in the material's curve atlas), for example density to smoke color. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Extract Channel](vop/substrate_channel.md) | Extracts one channel of an RGBA value. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Float Constant](vop/substrate_constant.md) | A constant float. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Float Mask Primvar [0..1]](vop/substrate_primvar.md) | Reads a float primvar of the mesh in [0, 1] as a mask, for example wetness. One per graph. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Float Multiply](vop/substrate_multiply.md) | Multiplies two floats. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Float Ramp](vop/substrate_float_ramp.md) | Remaps a float through a ramp (a UE curve in the material's curve atlas). |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Float Saturate](vop/substrate_saturate.md) | Clamps a float to [0, 1]. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Float to Color](vop/substrate_color_from_float.md) | Copies a float into red, green and blue. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Haziness to Second Roughness](vop/substrate_haziness.md) | Converts a roughness and a haziness into a Slab's second roughness and its weight (a hazy gloss). |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [MaterialX Surface](vop/substrate_materialx.md) | A MaterialX material on the stage, from the prepared MaterialX library, used as a Substrate surface. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Metalness to Albedo and F0](vop/substrate_metalness.md) | Converts metalness-workflow values (base color, metallic, specular) into a Slab's diffuse albedo and F0. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Normal Map](vop/substrate_normalmap.md) | Decodes a tangent-space normal map for a Slab's Normal input. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Scalar Parameter](vop/substrate_scalar.md) | A named float parameter of the material, editable on the material without recompiling. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Add](vop/substrate_add.md) | Adds two surfaces' light (Substrate Add), as for a glow over a surface. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Convert To Decal](vop/substrate_decal.md) | A decal material for hdUE Decal prims: UE's Substrate Convert To Decal over a surface, projected onto what the decal's box covers. Wire it to the builder's output, and bind the material to the decal prim. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Eye](vop/substrate_eye.md) | UE's Substrate Eye BSDF, for eyes modeled as UE's eye shading expects (cornea, iris and their normals). |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Hair](vop/substrate_hair.md) | UE's Substrate Hair BSDF, for hair cards. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Horizontal Mix](vop/substrate_horizontal.md) | Mixes two surfaces side by side (Substrate horizontal mixing). |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Select](vop/substrate_select.md) | Picks one of two surfaces where Select is below or above the threshold (Substrate Select). |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Single Layer Water](vop/substrate_water.md) | UE's Substrate Single Layer Water BSDF: a water surface with its medium below, rendered by UE's water pass. It must be the material's whole surface. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Slab](vop/substrate_slab.md) | One Substrate slab: diffuse and specular reflection, with optional simple-volume subsurface scattering. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Thin Film](vop/substrate_thin_film.md) | Iridescence of a thin film (soap bubbles, oil, coatings): F0 and F90 for a Slab (Substrate Thin-Film). |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Unlit](vop/substrate_unlit.md) | An emissive surface without lighting. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Vertical Layer](vop/substrate_vertical.md) | Layers one surface over another (Substrate vertical layering). |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Volumetric Fog Cloud](vop/substrate_volume_fog_cloud.md) | A volume material for Volume prims: UE's Substrate Volumetric Fog Cloud BSDF, rendered as a heterogeneous volume. Wire it to the builder's output, and bind the material to a Volume prim. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Substrate Weight](vop/substrate_weight.md) | Scales a surface's coverage. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Texture Sample](vop/substrate_texture.md) | Samples an image file, or UDIM tiles from a <UDIM> pattern. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Transmittance to MFP](vop/substrate_transmittance.md) | Converts the color light keeps through a thickness into a Slab's mean free path. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [UV Coordinates](vop/substrate_uv.md) | The mesh's UV set, scaled then offset. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [Volume Field](vop/substrate_volume_field.md) | A grid of the Volume prim at the shaded point. |
| <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> [hdUE Substrate Builder](vop/substrate_builder.md) | Composes a UE Substrate material from hdUE Substrate nodes. Like a Karma Material Builder, it goes in a Material Library LOP (or /mat, with the library's Material VOP pointing at it), which authors the material's typed USD graph; hdUE prepares that graph into a native Substrate material. |
